title: Rejection probability from distance
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $w$ be a Boolean string of length $n$. If its distance to the nearer constant string is the smaller of the fractions of false and true entries, then the rejection probability of the tester that samples two coordinates independently and uniformly and accepts exactly when their values agree is $\frac12-\frac12(1-2d)^2$, where $d$ is that distance.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $n$
